svg.title: dnaprs workflow metro map
svg.desc: Raw target genotypes, GWAS summary statistics and verified references pass through target quality control, PLINK C plus T or SBayesRC scoring, optional phenotype models, and a portable report.
svg.text: PGEN · BED · PED/MAP · BGEN · VCF/BCF · FinalReport
Inputs are read-only; resolved paths and checks are recorded.
Gaussian, logistic or mixed models declared directly in YAML or CLI parameters.
Portable HTML, downloadable figures, scientific tables and Nextflow execution records.
Nextflow parallelises cohorts, chromosomes, traits and models, then validates each deterministic gather.
adapted to the nf-core metro-map visual language
